species.real: As a boy Dylan Thomas was stranded on Worm's Head by the tide and later wrote about it, so even Wales's great poet once misread a tide table.
species.name: Wurmlet

dex.text: A little grey-green serpent that sleeps in the rock pools of the Worm and wakes up cross whenever the tide leaves without it. Its crest crackles before a squall.
dex.fact: Worm's Head takes its name from the Old Norse 'ormr', a serpent or dragon. It is a tidal island, cut off from the mainland for most of every tide.

species.real: The ribs of the Helvetia, wrecked in 1887, still poke out of the sand on Rhossili beach below Worm's Head.
species.name: Ormwyrm

dex.text: Lies off the end of Gower with its head raised, as long as a headland and nearly as patient. When the swell is up it breathes through the rock with a boom you can hear in Rhossili.
dex.fact: The blowhole on the Outer Head of Worm's Head roars and spouts when the swell and tide are right. The causeway out is only safe for about two and a half hours either side of low water.
